name: IHH
recent: IHH Healthcare 近期主要出现 EPF 连续多日申报持股变动，市场新闻亦聚焦 EPF 增减持。另有报道指公司计划裁减近 400 个职位。
notable: EPF 在多个交易日申报增持 IHH Healthcare 股份。
媒体报道 IHH Healthcare 计划裁减近 400 个职位。
报道指法务审计不构成 IHH 增持 Fortis 股权的障碍。
risks: EPF 连续多日申报持股变动，需留意大股东持股比例变化。
有报道提及私立医院可能出现供应过剩。
公司计划裁减近 400 个职位。

recent_en: IHH Healthcare has recently seen a series of EPF shareholding change disclosures, with news coverage focused on EPF's acquisitions and changes in its stake. There are also reports that the company plans to cut nearly 400 jobs and that its plan to raise its stake in India's Fortis has new developments.
notable_en: EPF disclosed acquisitions of IHH Healthcare shares on multiple trading days.
Media reported that IHH Healthcare plans to cut nearly 400 jobs.
Reports said a forensic audit is not an obstacle to IHH raising its stake in Fortis.
risks_en: EPF has disclosed shareholding changes on consecutive days; changes in the major shareholder's stake should be monitored.
Reports mentioned a potential oversupply of private hospitals.
The company plans to cut nearly 400 jobs.
earnings_en: For the period ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 7,046,000,000 and net income was MYR 573,000,000, with a net margin of 8.1%; revenue rose 7.5% QoQ and 11.9% YoY, while net income rose 8.5% QoQ and 29.3% YoY.
